title: config/extraction/embedding.yaml
description: Element embeddings written by the extraction-agent (T4.1b, KG schema 0.5.0). The embedding route comes from the project's llmPolicy (embed-default, embed-local).

dimension.description: Must equal the dimension of the vector index element_embedding in contracts/kg/init.cypher; longer vectors are cut and re-normalized.

maxElementsPerRun.description: Cost cap per skill call; elements beyond it are skipped with a warning.
